title: tool_manifest
description: v6.9 Scope O Layer 2 — every controller-side declarative tool ships as a YAML file conforming to this schema. Manifest_loader validates at startup, refuses to register anything that fails. Layer 3 (v7.5) will reuse this same schema as the meta-schema QB-proposed manifests must satisfy before sandbox validation runs; keep it tight so a rogue proposal can't smuggle in an escape.

name.description: Dotted-lowercase tool name; matches mcpd's naming convention.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump when a breaking impl change lands.

description.description: One-sentence human description; surfaces in HITL confirmation card and audit lines.

param_schema.description: Inline JSON Schema for the tool's params dict. Enforced pre-dispatch (INV-4).

sandbox.description: Sandbox rules the manifest_loader derives Landlock/Seccomp from. Optional for controller-side impl.kinds (session_op) since they touch no OS surface; required for mcpd-side impl.kinds (fs_read/fs_write_cow/dbus_call/exec_pipeline).

kind.description: The impl primitive that services this tool. Controller dispatches session_op locally; the other kinds go to mcpd (Layer 2 Part B).

op.description: For session_op: the operation name (set_cwd, set_default_editor, ...).

binary.description: For exec_pipeline: absolute path to the binary. NEVER interpolated from params.

args_template.description: For exec_pipeline: hardcoded arg list; may reference params via {{param_name}}.
